title: Something's Got to Give
overview: Years after his wife Ellen was lost at sea, Nick has her declared legally dead and promptly remarries. That same day, Ellen is rescued from a desert island and returns home. This unfinished remake of "My Favorite Wife" was the last film Marilyn Monroe worked on before her death in August 1962.
